summary: Comprehensive TDD test suite with strong unit test coverage (5 cycles), good workflow structure validation, and basic end-to-end integration tests via act. Well-organized with clear fixtures, appropriate mocking strategy (mock for unit tests, real fixtures for integration), and precise output validation (pipe-delimited, exact values). Gap: Act tests limited to 2 happy-path cases—missing negative scenarios (bad config, missing files, invalid JSON during pipeline run). Fixture files referenced but not shown in prompt, so their correctness cannot be fully verified. Module structure (Export-ModuleMember) not tested. Act test setup is complex but lacks error handling. Would catch most regressions in happy path; error-path coverage in CI pipeline is underspecified.
